mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations adjust to higher growth expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST rises by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with a falling federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a weakening labor market and monetary easing, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.2pp and FEDFUNDS falls by more than 0.1pp in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a deceleration in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals the onset of a slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors price in reduced future earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions with GDPC1 growth below 1.5% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: Rising non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate strengthening labor market conditions and consumer spending, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as equity markets react to near-term economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises by more than 100k in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and industrial activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 95.0) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise while industrial production (INDPRO) falls, it indicates a sectoral imbalance where demand is strong in housing but weak in manufacturing, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as market confidence wanes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST rises by more than 1% and INDPRO falls by more than 0.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 250), a high CPI level signals persistent inflation pressures that lead to aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances during high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 250) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
